reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as it correctly links atomic size mismatch to lattice distortion and dislocation pinning, a well-established strengthening mechanism in HEAs, and it appropriately restricts the boundary to single-phase FCC alloys to avoid confounding phase effects.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, using standard techniques (XRD, TEM, tensile tests) to measure lattice distortion and strength, and it provides a decisive falsification criterion: no measurable decrease in lattice distortion and no reduction in yield strength.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis is highly useful because it directly addresses the core question of what governs mechanical property differences in this alloy system, proposes a controlled, systematic investigation, and offers a clear mechanistic framework that would guide experimental design and interpretation.
